mapper.select: SELECT t1.DAY_IJA AS hmDayIja , t1.MISU_IJA AS hmMisuIja , TRUNC(NVL(ig.GUGAN_IJA, 0) * (NVL(t1.BFIL_AEKM,0) + NVL(t1.MEIB_AEKM,0) - NVL(t1.MEDO_AEKM,0))) AS hmGuganIja , t1.SUNG_COST AS hmSungCost , t1.SUNG_TAX AS hmSungTax , t1.SUNN_TAX AS hmSunnTax , t1.YESU_TAX AS hmYesuTax , NVL(t1.BFIL_AEKM,0) + NVL(t1.MEIB_AEKM,0) - NVL(t1.MEDO_AEKM,0) AS hmAekm , NVL(t1.BFIL_CHUI_AEK,0) + NVL(t1.MEIB_AEK,0) - NVL(t1.MEDO_AEK,0) AS hmChuiAek , t1.ANBUN_AEK AS hmAnbunAek , t1.PYUNGA_AEK AS hmPyungaAek , t1.SIGA_AEK AS hmSigaAek , t1.SANGHW_AEK AS hmSanghwAek , t2.PYOM_IYUL AS hjPyomIyul , TO_CHAR(t2.BALH_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS hjBalhYmd , TO_CHAR(t2.SANGHW_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS hjSanghwYmd , TO_CHAR(t2.AF_IJA_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS hjAfIjaYmd , NVL(t1.BFIL_SUNSU_IJA,0) + NVL(t1.UP_SUNSU_IJA,0) - NVL(t1.DW_SUNSU_IJA,0) AS sunsuIja , NVL(t1.DW_SUNSU_IJA,0) AS dwSunsuIja FROM SHM0HM t1 JOIN SHM0HJ t2 ON t2.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND t2.JM_CD = t1.JM_CD LEFT JOIN SHJ0IG ig ON ig.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ig.JM_CD = t1.JM_CD AND TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN ig.BF_IJA_YMD AND (ig.AF_IJA_YMD - 1) WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.FUND_CD = #{fundCd} AND t1.JM_CD = #{jmCd} AND t1.YMD = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD')
